name: B-820 Infrared Sauna
description: One of our most popular models, this model is a diminutive beauty. Perfect for one or two people, with its footprint of less than 16 sq. ft., this IR sauna can be easily incorporated into an in-home workout area, master bath, even in the master bedroom. This model has the same fully-loaded features as the larger models, including the same 77” height.
